tools.name: get_hosting_plans
tools.description: Returns imFORZA managed WordPress hosting plan details — Starter, Growth, and Scale tiers with monthly and annual pricing, included features, storage, and expert support hours per tier. Use when a buyer is evaluating hosting.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Returns the imFORZA service list with descriptions, pricing tiers, and URLs. Use when a buyer asks what imFORZA offers or how much services cost. Pass an optional category to filter results.

category.description: Optional filter. One of: hosting, websites, marketing, hubspot, seo, funnels.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Returns structured information about imFORZA — company description, services overview, contact details, support hours, and key URLs. Use this first to understand who imFORZA is before answering buyer questions.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Searches the imFORZA help center and returns matching support articles with titles, excerpts, and URLs. Use when a user has a support question or is troubleshooting an issue with their imFORZA-managed site.

query.description: Search query — e.g. "how to clear cache", "update plugin", "add new user"
